title: foundry eval case
description: One golden case for the judge or cynic prompt, one per file at evals/golden/<id>.json. Foundry ADR-0007, section 2.

id.description: Lowercase words of letters and digits joined by single hyphens; equals the file name without .json.

source.description: The run file the case came from, .git/foundry/<run-id>/<path>, relative to the git common dir: strip .git/ and resolve against git rev-parse --git-common-dir. Forward slashes; no segment starts with a dot, so no .. and no absolute path.

input.description: The brief handed to the role, verbatim. A judge input has no line starting VERDICT:; a cynic input never contains RECOMMEND.
